build_note: Installed from the pinned pure-Python py3-none-any mitmproxy wheel and its runtime requirements (manylinux and py3 wheels) by hash; the image checks the MIT classifier and that mitmproxy/dns.py, mitmproxy/net/dns/domain_names.py and the LICENSE match recorded SHA-256 values.
dependencies_note: The full runtime requirement set of mitmproxy 12.3.1 is installed from pinned wheels because importing mitmproxy.dns imports mitmproxy.flow (connections, certificates, proxy mode specs). Only DNSMessage.unpack runs; no proxy, server, event loop or socket is started. atheris 3.1.0 is the in-process fuzz bridge only.
coverage: Python line tracing of mitmproxy/dns.py and the mitmproxy/net/dns package during valid-control replay; Atheris import instrumentation for the byte-input bridge
scope: One RFC 1035 DNS message from local bytes via mitmproxy.dns.DNSMessage.unpack: header flags (the 3-bit field after RA is kept as reserved), questions, and CNAME/A/AAAA/MX answers with compressed names; valid response and query controls only. unpack decompresses names inside CNAME/MX RDATA; A/AAAA text comes from the record's ipv4_address/ipv6_address properties, CNAME from domain_name, and the MX preference and exchange from the decompressed RDATA through the library's domain_names.unpack_from. The section counts are the parsed list lengths.
